elements.text: Face and physiological benchmarks have separate evidence roles. DENS / DREAMER access checked; no new physiology result.
GamER  ·  FER2013  ·  DEAP  ·  WESAD  ·  Saraga  ·  Open-Meteo

Resource	Role	Access / current evidence
Raag Ratnakar	Metadata and Navrasa weights	72 ragas, 528 entries, 516 unique URLs
FER2013	Real facial CPU training / test	Version 1, 63.3 MB ZIP. ODbL / DbCL advertised
DEAP / WESAD	Physiological affect benchmarks	Access review. Not raga-response data
GamER	Real paired EEG + ECG evaluation	Fixed-game / fixed-30s tests, held-out people
Saraga / CompMusic	Future features and metadata	Saraga data: CC BY-NC. Check each source
IndRaga	Future precomputed audio features	Primary DOI record unavailable in review
Weather: Open-Meteo or manual entry. Model-based city data; experimental Ritu preference.
